title_zh: 国防部和军方人员将因发表针对女兵的性别歧视言论而受到纪律处分。
description: Following complaints by a female soldier about sexist social media comments from colleagues, several defense employees will be spoken to about their behavior on social media, said junior defense mi
description_zh: 一名女兵投诉同事在社交媒体上发表性别歧视言论后，国防部一名初级军官表示，将与几名国防部雇员谈及他们在社交媒体上的行为。

title: Video: 49 people on Dutch coach bus that crashed in Switzerland; Multiple deaths
title_zh: 视频：一辆载有49人的荷兰长途客车在瑞士发生车祸；多人死亡
description: There were 49 people on board aDutch coach bus involved in a serious accidentin Switze
description_zh: 一辆荷兰长途客车在瑞士发生严重交通事故，车上共有49人。

title: Italo hopes to run trains to Germany, Netherlands, Belgium within 5 years
title_zh: Italo希望在5年内开通通往德国、荷兰和比利时的列车。
description: The Italian rail operator Italo is expanding to the Netherlands, Germany, and Belgium after a 3.6 billion investment into German high-speed trains.
description_zh: 意大利铁路运营商 Italo 在向德国高速列车项目投资 36 亿欧元后，正将业务拓展至荷兰、德国和比利时。

title: Car crashes during police chase near Venlo; One killed, two hurt
title_zh: 芬洛附近警方追捕过程中发生车祸；一人死亡，两人受伤
description: Three people were injured when their car crashed during a police chase on the A73 highway near Venlo early Friday morning.
description_zh: 周五清晨，在芬洛附近的A73高速公路上，警方追捕过程中一辆汽车发生车祸，造成车内三人受伤。

title: PSV start UEFA Champions League campaign with a 1-1 home draw against Shakhtar Donetsk
title_zh: 埃因霍温在欧冠联赛首轮主场1-1战平顿涅茨克矿工。
description: PSV picked up a point on Thursday evening at home against Shakhtar Donetsk in the UEFA Champions League.
description_zh: 周四晚间，埃因霍温在欧冠联赛主场对阵顿涅茨克矿工的比赛中拿到一分。

title: Several killed, wounded in after Dutch coach crashes in Switzerland
title_zh: 瑞士发生荷兰长途客车相撞事故，多人伤亡
description: Several people were killed and others were wounded after a tour bus with Dutch license plates crashed in Susch, Graubünden, on Thursday in Susch, Graubünden, on Thursday evening.
description_zh: 周四晚上，一辆挂有荷兰车牌的旅游巴士在格劳宾登州苏施发生车祸，造成多人死亡，多人受伤。

title: Utrecht reopens city center street rocked by January explosion; Residents still angered
title_zh: 乌特勒支市中心街道重新开放，该街道曾于1月份发生爆炸；居民仍然愤怒不已
description: The Visschersteeg in Utrecht city center has reopened to the public almost eight months after a
description_zh: 乌特勒支市中心的维舍尔斯蒂格在关闭近八个月后重新向公众开放。

title: Environmental organization granted permission in court for climate case against ING
title_zh: 环保组织获准向法院提起针对荷兰国际集团（ING）的气候诉讼。
description: Milieudefensie can proceed with itsclimate lawsuit against INGafter the Amste
description_zh: Amste 事件后，Milieudefensie 可以继续针对 ING 提起气候诉讼

title: Government set to ban employers from deducting rent from migrant workers' wages
title_zh: 政府拟禁止雇主从外籍劳工工资中扣除房租
description: Employers will be banned from deducting rent from migrant workers’ wages from mid-2028, Social Affairs Minister Hans Vijlbrief told the Tweede Kamer, the lower house of Dutch parliament, on Thursda
description_zh: 社会事务部长汉斯·维尔布里夫周四在荷兰议会下院（Tweede Kamer）宣布，从2028年中期起，雇主将被禁止从外籍劳工的工资中扣除房租。

title: Investigation launched into potential corruption by cardiologists, 8 buildings searched
title_zh: 针对心脏病专家的潜在腐败行为展开调查，搜查了8栋建筑物。
description: The Fiscal Information and Investigation Service (FIOD) is investigating potential corruption by cardiologists.
description_zh: 财政信息和调查服务处 (FIOD) 正在调查心脏病专家的潜在腐败行为。

title: Five Dutch men arrested after 20,000 kilos of fireworks are discovered in Germany
title_zh: 德国警方查获2万公斤烟花，五名荷兰男子被捕
description: The discovery of 20,000 kilos of heavy fireworks in a German bunker earlier this year has led to six arrests in the Netherlands and Germany.
description_zh: 今年早些时候，德国一个地堡中发现了 2 万公斤重型烟花，导致荷兰和德国逮捕了六人。

title: Younger Dutch have nearly twice as much trust in politics as older adults
title_zh: 年轻的荷兰人对政治的信任度几乎是年长者的两倍。
description: Younger people in the Netherlands have become more engaged with the politics in recent years.
description_zh: 近年来，荷兰的年轻人越来越积极地参与政治活动。

title: Cops shot in Overasselt gang violence were brand new on the job
title_zh: 在奥弗阿塞尔特帮派暴力事件中被枪击的警察都是新入职的。
description: The two officers injured in afatal shooting in Overasseltlast wee
description_zh: 上周在奥弗阿塞尔特发生的致命枪击事件中受伤的两名警官

title: Dutch exports to the U.S. drop by a quarter
title_zh: 荷兰对美国的出口下降了四分之一
description: Dutch exports to the United States totaled 13 billion euros in the first six months of the year, down 25 percent from the same period in 2025, Statistics Netherlands has reported.
description_zh: 荷兰统计局报告称，今年上半年荷兰对美国的出口总额为 130 亿欧元，比 2025 年同期下降了 25%。

title: Four people were euthanized due to post-Covid complaints in 2025
title_zh: 2025年，有四人因新冠后遗症而被实施安乐死。
description: Four people were euthanized in the Netherlands in 2025, with post-COVID syndrome cited as the main reason for ending their lives.
description_zh: 2025 年，荷兰有 4 人被实施安乐死，新冠肺炎后遗症是结束他们生命的主要原因。

title: Relationship between parents and schools deteriorating: Education Council
title_zh: 教育委员会：家长与学校关系恶化
description: Relations between parents and schools appear to be becoming increasingly adversarial, the Education Council said in an advisory report to Minister Rianne Letschert of Education, Culture,
description_zh: 教育委员会在一份提交给教育文化部长里安娜·莱切特的咨询报告中指出，家长与学校之间的关系似乎日益变得敌对。

title: Four people with long Covid euthanised in NL last year
title_zh: 去年荷兰有四名患有新冠后遗症的患者被实施安乐死。
description: Four people died by euthanasia last year after suffering with long Covid, according to the Dutch regional euthanasia review committee....
description_zh: 据荷兰地区安乐死审查委员会称，去年有四人在遭受新冠后遗症折磨后接受了安乐死。

title: Roof of PM’s office is original 16th-century flat-plack
title_zh: 首相办公室的屋顶是16世纪的原始平顶板。
description: The roof of the Torentje, or Little Tower, at the Binnenhof in The Hague was built in 1547 as a...
description_zh: 海牙宾嫩霍夫宫的小塔（Torentje）的屋顶建于1547年……

title: Parents as “customers” fuelling school disputes, council says
title_zh: 市议会称，家长作为“顾客”加剧了学校纠纷。
description: Parents are falling out with schools and turning to dispute committees to settle grievances, according to the the government’s independent...
description_zh: 据政府独立机构称，家长与学校关系紧张，转而求助于纠纷委员会来解决矛盾……

title: Dutch regulator acts against Irish companies over welfare concerns in calf transports
title_zh: 荷兰监管机构对爱尔兰公司在犊牛运输过程中存在的福利问题采取行动
description: The Dutch Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) has decided to take action against Irish companies importing very young calves from Ireland.
description_zh: 荷兰食品和消费品安全局 (NVWA) 已决定对从爱尔兰进口幼牛的爱尔兰公司采取行动。

title: Nearly 40% of family lawyers face threats, especially in domestic violence cases
title_zh: 近40%的家庭律师面临威胁，尤其是在家庭暴力案件中。
description: Nearly 40 percent of family law attorneys face threats, according to a survey by Investico in collaboration with RTL Nieuws and the Groene Amsterdammer.
description_zh: 根据 Investico 与 RTL Nieuws 和 Groene Amsterdammer 联合进行的一项调查，近 40% 的家庭法律师面临威胁。

title: iPhone Duo to launch in Netherlands at nearly €2,350
title_zh: iPhone Duo 将在荷兰上市，售价近 2350 欧元
description: Apple unveiled its latest iPhone on Wednesday. The iPhone 18 Duo is the tech giant’s first foldable phone and comes at a hefty price tag.
description_zh: 苹果公司周三发布了最新款iPhone。这款名为iPhone 18 Duo的手机是这家科技巨头推出的首款可折叠手机，售价不菲。

title: Kids misled, exposed to crime, inappropriate behavior at commercial football academies
title_zh: 商业足球学院误导儿童，让他们接触犯罪和不当行为。
description: Commercial football academies are becoming increasingly common in the Netherlands, but this rapidly growing sector is still unregulated and unsupervised.
description_zh: 商业足球学院在荷兰越来越普遍，但这个快速发展的行业仍然缺乏监管。

title: Amsterdam mayor fails to win EU backing to limit rentals of primary homes to tourists
title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹市长限制向游客出租主要住宅的提案未能获得欧盟支持。
description: Amsterdam mayor Femke Halsema has failed in her lobbying of the European Commission to tighten rules on locals renting their home to tourists, De Telegraaf
description_zh: 据《电讯报》报道，阿姆斯特丹市长费姆克·哈尔塞玛游说欧盟委员会收紧当地居民将房屋出租给游客的规定的努力失败了。

title: Police start search for driver who hit a child before speeding away in Gouda
title_zh: 在豪达，警方开始搜寻撞倒一名儿童后加速逃逸的司机。
description: A driver fled the scene after colliding with a child in Gouda on Thursday morning in an apparent hit-and-run. Police are currently searching for a black SUV.
description_zh: 周四上午，在豪达市，一名司机撞倒一名儿童后逃逸。警方目前正在搜寻一辆黑色SUV。

title: Two more deaths linked to West Nile virus in the Netherlands; Infections double to 18
title_zh: 荷兰新增两例与西尼罗河病毒相关的死亡病例；感染人数翻倍至18人。
description: Two more people in the Netherlands have died as a result of symptoms caused by a West Nile virus infection according to Dutch public health institute RIVM.
description_zh: 据荷兰公共卫生研究所RIVM称，荷兰又有两人因感染西尼罗河病毒引起的症状而死亡。

title: Municipality of Amsterdam announce plans to scrap 2,500 full-time jobs by 2030
title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹市政府宣布计划到2030年裁减2500个全职工作岗位。
description: The municipality of Amsterdam has plans to scrap 2,500 full-time jobs before 2030. Alderman Hendrik Jan Biemond wrote to the city council that the job cuts are based on the coalition agreement.
description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹市政府计划在 2030 年前裁减 2500 个全职工作岗位。市议员亨德里克·扬·比蒙德致信市议会，称裁员是根据联合执政协议进行的。

title: Calves shipped from Ireland go 50 hours without milk, NVWA says
title_zh: 据NVWA称，从爱尔兰运来的小牛有50个小时没有奶水。
description: The Dutch food and product safety authority NVWA is taking enforcement action against four Irish livestock transporters over the treatment...
description_zh: 荷兰食品和产品安全管理局NVWA正对四家爱尔兰牲畜运输商采取执法行动，原因是他们处理牲畜的方式存在问题……
